sourceParts: eleven actual image_gen-painted components, not new independent pose drawings
phaseIntegration: phase += distanceTraveled / (strideRigPx * displayHeight / frameHeight); use wrapped phase*count. Fixed fps is preview speed only.
weightTransfer: torso/shoulder/hip y = restY + 3*sin(4*pi*t); feet and cane remain independently constrained. Less than 1 displayed pixel amplitude.
rendering: Each part uses fixed uniform scale then rigid rotation+translation. Angles are world radians in image coordinates. Child attachment points are generated by parent FK/IK; emitted world transforms are bake evidence.
